instruction: Candid outdoor medium shot of a group in a grassy park. In the foreground, a bald light-skinned man with a beard in a dark blue t-shirt and black pants (R2) stands on the right, looking left. In front of him, a woman in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans (R4) leans forward with hands outstretched to catch. In the background, a Black woman with an afro in a red t-shirt (R6), an Asian man in a red polo shirt (R3), and a woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) watch. The lighting is soft natural daylight.
